exposure: Baricitinib exposure before conception and during the first 17 weeks of gestation
cohort: A 43-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis who became pregnant while on baricitinib treatment.
finding: Continuous exposure to baricitinib during the first 17 weeks of pregnancy in this case was associated with a positive pregnancy outcome, characterized by normal fetal growth and no detected macroscopic abnormalities.
